scope: Payloads that execute through client-side DOM sinks or polyglot parsing across several contexts.
exclusions: Server-reflected payloads with no client sink belong to xss_reflected_stored
Static JavaScript assets with no attacker-controlled fragment
required_evidence: Client-side sink context such as innerHTML, eval, or location
Source of the attacker-controlled fragment or parameter
Browser-side rendering or script context evidence
benign_counterexamples: Documentation page with a JavaScript snippet in a code block
Single-page app routing that reads a legitimate hash parameter
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
